description: Defines the LocalTaskStore class for managing task data with persistence, including load, save, add, update, delete, and setCompleted methods.

classes.name: LocalTaskStore
classes.description: Manages task storage with in-memory state and persistent storage using SharedPreferences, supporting add, update, delete, and toggle completion.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tasks from SharedPreferences, decoding JSON string into list of Task objects.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Saves the current list of tasks to SharedPreferences as a JSON string.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a list of Task objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a list of Task objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task with given title and description, assigns a new ID, updates state and persists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with new title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a task by ID and updates state and storage.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion status of a task by ID and updates state and storage.
